author: GamingBolt
description:
WARDOGS doesn't necessarily do anything new within the FPS space. There is nothing here that you won't have seen before if you are well versed in the genre. 

However, it does include a huge variety of these tried and tested systems and executes each of them pretty well.
While WARDOGS is not a perfect game, it is well worth checking out if you are looking for an addictive and rewarding experience that feels almost nostalgic in an era where FPS games increasingly rely on overly complicated gameplay systems that ultimately feel unsatisfying and tiresome.
title: Wardogs Early Access Review - An Addictive and Rewarding Experience

author: GamingBolt
description:
Silent Hill often feels like an empire in history that rose to great heights before eventually fading away into legend, only to be revived once again to shine brighter than it ever managed in the past. That’s a comeback story that any franchise in modern gaming would love to have, but isn’t it what comes after the return that matters the most for its future?

We think Konami deserves the benefit of the doubt after three successive hits in the franchise thanks to Townfall bring as good as it is. 

Heck, we suspect that the franchise’s new renaissance might just be getting started. Curious? That’s awesome! Join us as we tell you more about why we think Konami might be on to something with this one.
title: The Rise, Fall And Rise of Silent Hill

author: GamingBolt
description:
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve isn’t trying to be a realistic simulation of aerial combat. You’re not spending hours learning the intricacies of flying. 

You’re pulling off ridiculous manoeuvres, locking onto enemy fighters, and piercing through billowing clouds while an orchestral score swells behind you. Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve puts you in the cockpit, dims the lights, turns up the volume, and makes you feel like the star of your very own aviation blockbuster.
title: Why Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Is Shaping Up To Be One of the Biggest Games of 2026
